title: Topic 2
japanese_text:
A：最近シェアハウスに入ってきた人が朝までゲームしてるせいで、寝不足なんだよね。
B：それって睡眠<u>妨害</u>じゃん！
A：あまりにもひどいから引っ越しも考えてる。この間なんか<u>住人</u>の物が<u>紛失</u>する<u>騒動</u>もあったし…。
english_translation: A: I'm not getting enough sleep, because the guy who recently moved into my share house plays games all night. B: But that interferes with your sleep! A: It's so bad I'm thinking of moving out. There was also a commotion the other day because some of the residents' things went missing.
